title: GovEagle adds forwarded task order notices to Discover
summary: Forward task order notices from your contract vehicles to GovEagle. Each notice and its attachments show up in Discover, scored like any other listing.
body_markdown:
You can now forward task order notices from your contract vehicles to GovEagle. Each notice shows up in Discover with its attachments, scored like any other listing.


## What changed


Many of the best opportunities never reach SAM.gov. They arrive as task order requests emailed to holders of a contract vehicle, and they're easy to lose in an inbox. Now:


- **Built for your contract vehicles.** GovEagle can now integrate with any GWAC or IDIQ through an email inbox. An admin generates the forwarding address under **Settings → Discover → Sources** .
- **Attachments included.** GovEagle reads the email and its attached documents to fill in the listing details.
- **Scored for fit.** The notice appears in Discover labeled with its source, scored against your company like every other match.
- **Only the senders you trust.** Each forwarding address accepts mail only from the senders or domains you list. Incomplete or conflicting notices are held for review instead of going straight into Discover.


## Who it helps


Capture teams at firms that hold IDIQs and GWACs, where task order requests reach one person or a shared mailbox and the rest of the team hears about them late.


## How forwarding works


1. An admin opens **Settings → Discover** , finds the vehicle under **Sources** and clicks **Set up** .
2. In **Allowed senders** , enter the agency's sending address or domain, and the mailbox that will forward the notices.
3. Click **Generate email address** and copy it right away. It's shown only once.
4. Forward notices to that address, or set a forwarding rule in your email so every notice goes there.


Get GovCon capture and proposal insights in your inbox.


## Where it fits


Forwarded notices are part of Discover in[GovEagle's capture workspace](https://www.goveagle.com/solutions/bd-capture) . From Discover, add a notice to your pipeline like any other listing. For finding the vehicles worth holding, read[how to find task order opportunities under IDIQ contracts](https://www.goveagle.com/blog/find-idiq-vehicles-task-orders) .


## What it doesn't do


- **Documents need to be attached.** GovEagle reads the email and its attachments, so attach the files you want on the listing.
- **Unlisted senders are rejected.** GovEagle checks the address that sent it the email. The forwarding mailbox has to be on the list, even when the original agency sender is.
- **A lost address can't be recovered.** Revoke it and generate a new one.


## Get started


Forwarded notices are part of Discover, which is in beta. To get started, emailsupport@goveagle.com .
